note: Draft cards from the board design assessment. They are not on the board yet. Not included, for Tom to decide when they are filed: auto-start on any card, and the closing permission sentence the handoff rules put at the end of a prompt.

cards.title: Board redesign 1: an honest header and status
cards.next: Rebuilds the top of the board: a header that fits a phone, a light that says when the board's data is behind, new status words (a normal queue is no longer shown as Stuck in red), and a line saying what changed since you last looked. Cards and layout come in redesign 2 and 3. You test once, after redesign 3.

history.t: Added from the board design assessment (planning chat https://claude.ai/code/session_01RXeukFvqFwkYY6QshQt5jc). Tom: "Do a UX and visual design assessment of the kanban page as if it were a standalone kanban app dedicated to this project then create instructions and cards to execute" Plan: claude/boardux-plan.md.

prompt.what: Fixes the board's header and status so it fits your phone and tells the truth about what is running, queued or late. It also files the four redesign cards and copies the plan into the repo.
prompt.model: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (row B: the rules, colours and checks are written in claude/boardux-plan.md, and tests catch mistakes)
prompt.text: Read CLAUDE.md, claude/handoff-rules.md and the Project docs claude/boardux-plan.md and claude/boardux-cards.json. Your first push is the commit board: start c-boardux1. In that same push add the four cards from claude/boardux-cards.json to data/board.json (re-read the board first and merge; skip any already there) and copy the plan into the repo as claude/boardux-plan.md. Then build phase 1 (boardux1) as plan sections 3.2, 3.3 (not search or themes), 3.6 and 5 say, with checks A1, A2, A7, A8, A9 and A13, and push it as boardux1. Fetch and rebase before every push, because other sessions change board.html. Keep every feature the page has today (check A13). Run tools/board_shots.py and look at every picture before pushing. Write what you built, and anything that differs from the plan, into the plan's Built section. Do not start the next phase.

cards.title: Board redesign 2: cards and the card panel
cards.next: Waits on Board redesign 1 (c-boardux1). Then it redraws every card (short title, the instruction readable without opening it, one status line, one main button, undo on All good) and the panel that opens on a tap (main action always in view), and shortens the titles of the open cards.

cards.title: Board redesign 3: four views, search and the wide layout
cards.next: Waits on Board redesign 2 (c-boardux2). Then the board becomes four views with the same names at every screen size (For you, Claude, Chats, Shipped), with a tab bar on the phone, two columns clear of the fold on the open Duo, search, and Shipped grouped by day. After it ships you try the whole redesign once (card t-boarduxtry).

cards.title: Try the redesigned board on your phone
cards.next: After Board redesign 3 ships (build boardux3): open the board from your home screen with the Duo folded. 1) The header is one row and nothing slides sideways. 2) For you shows your cards first, and you can read what to do without opening one. 3) Tap a card: the main button is in view without scrolling. 4) Tap All good on a card you have finished, then Undo. 5) Search for "muffin". 6) Unfold the Duo and turn it sideways: the same four views, two columns, nothing across the fold. All good if it works; Something is wrong with what you saw.
